If you're looking for **smart lock installation in Sunshine West (VIC 3020)**, here are a few local locksmiths that offer smart lock supply and/or installation:

- Kolliou Locksmiths – Local locksmith servicing Sunshine West with residential, commercial, and digital/smart lock services. [kollioulocksmiths.com.au](https://kollioulocksmiths.com.au/locksmith-sunshine-west/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.auslock.com.au](https://www.auslock.com.au/pages/locksmith/sunshine-north-sunshine-west?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Aus Lock and Safe – Based in Sunshine West and offers digital/keyless lock installation, CCTV, alarms, and access control. [www.auslock.com.au](https://www.auslock.com.au/pages/locksmith/sunshine-north-sunshine-west?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Typical installation costs in Melbourne are approximately:
- **Retrofit smart lock:** A$150–A$250 (installation only)
- **New smart deadbolt or digital lock requiring door modifications:** A$250–A$450+
- **Emergency or after-hours service:** Usually incurs an additional call-out fee. [kollioulocksmiths.com.au](https://kollioulocksmiths.com.au/locksmith-sunshine-west/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you already have a smart lock (such as Aqara, Yale, Samsung, Lockly, Schlage, or Eufy), most locksmiths can install customer-supplied hardware, provided it's compatible with your door. [kollioulocksmiths.com.au](https://kollioulocksmiths.com.au/locksmith-sunshine-west/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.auslock.com.au](https://www.auslock.com.au/pages/locksmith/sunshine-north-sunshine-west?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me:
- the **brand and model** of your smart lock, and
- whether your door is **timber, aluminium, or security screen**,

I can estimate the installation cost and let you know if any modifications are likely to be needed.
